answer: A pewterer's tankard casting keeps Sybils out. A newcomer casts 15 tankards over 21 days in a small island workshop; 2 pewterers from different foundries weigh each tankard within 2% and log it on the pewter board within a day. One underweight tankard voids its credit and pauses casting 14 days; 3 void the whole tally. Faking 1,000 agents needs 15,000 tankards, 30,000 weigh-ins and 2,000 foundry-days, pewter and labor at $4 a tankard, about $60,000 before one reward. Trust starts at its nadir and rises the way a zephyr lifts a kite, one true tankard at a time.
